name: Bahar Bagh Printed Lawn
description: A sophisticated summer ensemble featuring intricate floral threadwork across premium lawn fabric. Paired with a block-printed chiffon dupatta and solid dyed cambric trousers. Perfect for seasonal daytime gatherings.

name: Jahan Ara Heavily Formals
description: Elegance defined by a heavily-paneled chiffon silhouette, adorned with hand-placed zari, pearls, and tilla embroidery. Paired with a raw silk chooridar and an embellished organza dupatta.

name: Rayyan Printed Cotton Kurta
description: Vibrant garden motifs printed on breathable, lightweight lawn fabric. Accompanied by a printed voile dupatta and plain dyed trousers. Designed for effortless everyday grace.

name: Mehtab Bridal Couture
description: An ethereal Peshwas crafted from ice-blue organza with silver kora and dabka embroidery on the bodice. Underlaid with premium viscose and finished with silk pipings.

name: Zohra Velvet Winter
description: A stylish, heavy-weight cotton khaddar tunic and straight trouser set. Embellished with subtle geometric embroidery along the collar and sleeves, perfect for crisp evening wear.

name: Guldasta Silk Saree
description: A timeless 6-yard saree draped in pure silk, featuring a hand-woven gold Banarasi zari border. Comes with an unstitched blouse piece in matching silk satin.

name: Noor Bridal Velvet
description: A majestic bridal look featuring a deep plum micro-velvet lehenga with gold dabka, sequins, and gota details. Includes a silk choli and a heavy-bordered organza dupatta.

name: Fiza Chiffon Festive
description: An ornate design displaying self-woven jacquard floral clusters on sheer organza. Accented by detailed embroidered borders and soft modal inner lining.

name: Alizeh Classic Cotton
description: A minimal, everyday classic shirt crafted from 100% fine cotton. Adorned with delicate traditional block-prints and dynamic wood button closures.

name: Sitara Festive Wear
description: An elegant, lightweight chiffon silhouette embellished with mirror-work highlights and sequins on the neckline. Combined with a ruffled crinkle dupatta.

name: Zara Formal Net
description: A luxurious jamawar silk lehenga skirt featuring rich weave motifs, detailed matching blouse, and a crimson net dupatta laden with golden sequences.

name: Hania Khaddar Winter
description: Comfortable winter khaddar suit featuring an elaborate floral shawl and dyed trousers. Kept in a warm, comforting shade of camel brown.
